tone.target: bright jangly edge-of-breakup alt rock rhythm
tone.profile: bright jangly edge-of-breakup alt rock rhythm
tone.summary: The signal chain uses a light boost for clarity, followed by a low-gain British amp model (UK 45) to achieve the 'edge-of-breakup' sound. Chorus adds sheen, while Digital Delay provides rhythmic depth. The overall tone is bright and jangly.

rig.name: Counting Crows - Mr. Jones - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Enhance pick attack and cut through the mix for jangly clarity.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD to maintain clean headroom while adding punch.

alternatives.reason: If more grit is needed, Green OD could be used.

blocks.purpose: Keep the gain clean and focused on natural amp breakup.
blocks.gap: No dedicated distortion needed; relying on the UK 45's inherent low-gain character.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean British combo sound (Vox/clean British combo clue).
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is the closest model to a classic Vox-style clean British tone.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if a more American clean sound was desired.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet voicing that complements the UK 45 amp.
Add the required 'light chorus sheen' without sounding washed out.
Provide the 'short delay' for rhythmic depth and chime.

alternatives.reason: If a warmer, less defined echo was preferred.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and dimension without sounding washed out.
blocks.gap: Using Room for a natural, non-metallic ambience.
